query: Here's the transcript from my discovery call with Brightline Mechanical. Help me turn it into a solution charter.
notes: Interactive. The runner plays the consultant (Sam) from the briefing, answering one question at a time, and must not show the briefing to the skill.
expected_behavior: Reads SKILL.md and both templates before asking anything
Runs intake in one message: confirms date, attendees, roles, and that Dana Reyes is the Decider
Summarizes what the transcript already settles before grilling, then asks one question at a time, each with a recommended answer
Treats 'the techs hate the paperwork' as a hypothesis (fails the specificity test) and the Kent capacitor story as an observation
Does not pick between 70% and 62% first-time fix, even when the consultant says 'use 62'; shows both and opens a follow-up
Puts 'the problem is we don't have a mobile app' under Directions, not in the problem statement
Asks 'how do you know?' for '$250 a truck roll' and 'could double agreement sales' and keeps both out of the charter as hypotheses
When the consultant pushes to include an unsourced number anyway, explains once and moves on
Narrows 'an hour a day per tech' to what was observed (about 25 minutes after one job) plus Jorge's own estimate
Runs a room-read pass anchored to transcript moments (@03:14, @04:22, @04:36, @05:20, @02:46) and one off-transcript sweep
Keeps Priya's email, the CEO/Coolwave pressure, Marcus's after-call comment and all room reads out of charter.md
Scopes every outcome to one ability link: time, money, physical effort, mental effort or routine (never social deviance)
Writes charter.md and consultant-notes.md with the template headings and markers; every _Open_ field has a follow-up
Follow-ups are client-safe and marked blocks alignment or strengthens charter

query: Just draft the charter from this transcript, I don't have time for questions.
expected_behavior: Skips the grilling and does not stall
Fills only fields the transcript supports; leaves others _Open_ with follow-ups
Lists the questions it would have asked the consultant, each with a recommended answer, under 'Questions for the consultant' in the notes
Still does not choose between 70% and 62%

query: Write a project charter for our office move: budget $80k, PM is Jen, authorize her to sign vendor contracts.
